lifecycle_detail: Four-family frontier campaign; first local measurement slice. Not a change to studio-wide priority.
north_star: Help builders create demonstrably better agents, prove their abilities in fair competitions, and make that progress enjoyable to watch and reproduce.

beneficiary.job_to_be_done: Improve a versioned agent and independently verify the change.
beneficiary.current_struggle: Weak opponents and incomplete runs can conceal tactical errors and regressions.
beneficiary.desired_progress: Reproducible comparison, useful retain decisions and earned improvement.

north_star_metric.name: Weekly returning builders completing verified improvement cycles
north_star_metric.definition: Distinct consented external builders with a qualifying cycle in an earlier UTC week who complete fixed admission and use the accepted improved version in a completed non-practice match within seven days. Finalize after the use window closes.
north_star_metric.qualifying_event: Predeclared effect and uncertainty gates, tactical and seat vetoes, resource-class parity, accepted candidate and completed match.
exclusions: Failed, capped, unverified or disqualified runs
north_star_metric.gameability: Easy games or weak opponents inflate gains; freeze qualified opposition, require absolute strength floors and relative gains.

proxies.name: Returning external builders completing replayable retain-or-promote comparisons
proxies.why: Useful feedback precedes qualified improvement; planned, not currently measured.
proxies.retire_when: Verified consented recurring account-to-admission-to-match joins exist.

proxies.name: Reproducible strength reports and tactical errors
proxies.retire_when: Real-user product metrics are verified; keep these only as diagnostics.

anti_goals: No claim of present industry leadership
No evaluation leakage or unsupported subscription reuse
No automatic publication or fabricated audience

done_when: Frozen opposition, both-seat tactical measurement and reproducible reports
validation: Hand-labeled disproof fixtures, tests, build, independent review
roadmap.disproof_condition: Grader cannot distinguish correct and deliberately wrong tactics.

done_when: Immutable model/provider/effort/prompt/memory/tool versions, attempt ledger, isolated partitions
non_goals: No arbitrary uploaded code or hidden credential reuse
validation: Mutation, contamination, budget and replay rejection
roadmap.disproof_condition: Admission cases are accessible to practice or a ranked version changes mid-match.

done_when: Repeatable matched-compute gains in two game families against nonrandom opposition, both seats and uncertainty
non_goals: No repeated grinding on spent holdouts
validation: Completion, legality, tactical and seat regression vetoes
roadmap.disproof_condition: Gains vanish against frozen stronger opposition or fail guardrails.

done_when: Train, compare, cancel, select, rollback and source-bound replay flows
non_goals: No native/store acceptance inferred from browser tests
validation: Responsive accessibility, cancellation/recovery, exact deployed source proof
roadmap.disproof_condition: Users cannot distinguish candidate, retained and accepted versions or safely cancel.

entry_evidence: Consented eligible routes and inference limits
done_when: Attributable replays, truthful share drafts, safe creator-adapter starter
non_goals: No automatic posts or ranking claims
validation: Actual identity availability, resource limits, replay and rollback
roadmap.disproof_condition: Identity or autonomous execution cannot be substantiated.

disagreements: 62 is Fable's original-draft score, not a score for the revised draft or an average.
Rejected the assertion that the completed short-game exploratory samples were capped.
No claim that hidden seeds alone demonstrate generalization.
review.final_ruling: Revised strategy remains draft. Operator-authorized first implementation proceeds after bounded review; no North Star adoption claim.

change_log.change: Drafted, refuted and revised. See FRONTIER_COUNCIL_RESULTS.md for exact route receipts and reconciliations.
